text:
sophia: Quick sync — finalizing launch decision heuristics for the realtime embeddings cache feature. Need clear owners for: SLA targets, docs/runbook, support playbook, monitoring signals, and pricing guardrails. cc @alex @jamal @lina. Proposed minimal acceptance: P99 latency target, docs (quickstart + known-limits + migration notes), support oncall + escalation, monitoring traces/alerts, pricing + trial cap. Thoughts?

alex: I can own SLA + monitoring. Quick ask — can we relax P99 to 250ms for the first week? tail spikes on small models worry me.

jamal: I'll take docs + support runbook. We should have a triage checklist + explicit fallback steps.

lina: I'll take pricing guardrails. High level: trial cap, pay-as-you-go per-token, and reserved tiers. Need numbers from finance to finalize.

ops-bot: deploy-bot: Canary scheduled -> Tue 02:00 UTC. Auto-rollback policy = on.

alex: If 200ms is the bar we miss it at scale. Recommend 250ms initial with an SLA improvement plan. Also: automatic fallback to a low-latency model variant is required. Add to runbook.

jamal: Will add fallback steps. Draft runbook snippet: 
``
triage steps:
1) Confirm scope (latency vs 5xx)
2) Switch routing: route 10% traffic -> fallback model variant
3) Notify oncall + PM channel
4) If >15m, scale Dedicated pool / trigger reserved capacity
5) Postmortem checklist and customer comms template
```

sophia: Good. Monitoring signals we need: P50/P95/P99 latency, tail queue depth, token throughput, 5xx rate, cache hit ratio, GPU utilization, SLO burn rate. Alex — map alerts -> who pages.

alex: Will add alert/SLO mapping in the infra repo PR. SLO burn-rate alert -> pager at 2x burn over 15m, sev2 at sustained 1h.

lina: Pricing tentative numbers: gen $0.0008/token, embed $0.0002/token; trial cap 5k tokens/day. Reserved capacity tiers TBD. I'll run model.

jamal: Support playbook additions: escalation path to infra (when to flip fallback), customer-facing status text, template for proactive outreach if outage >30m.

sophia: Two outstanding decisions to lock: (1) final P99 target (200ms vs 250ms) (2) trial cap confirm. Call for quick votes.

alex: vote: 250ms (engineering)

jamal: vote: 250ms (prod & support OK with fallback automation)

lina: vote: 250ms and trial cap = 5k/day

sophia: Consensus = 250ms P99 initial. We will commit to improvement milestones: 250ms week0, 220ms by week4, 200ms by week12 with monthly progress check and rollback guardrail if regressions.

sophia: Action items (owners + due):
- SLA + monitoring thresholds + alert mapping -> alex (EOD Thu)
- Support runbook + fallback steps -> jamal (tomorrow noon)
- Pricing final numbers + finance model -> lina (EOD Thu)
- Docs: quickstart + migration notes + known-limits -> jamal (EOD Fri)
- Canary + rollback verification -> infra -> ops-bot confirm pre-deploy checklist (Mon)
- Publish acceptance checklist and sign-off thread -> sophia (Mon PM)

alex: I'll open PR with alert config and SLO docs.

jamal: I'll drop runbook link when done.

lina: I'll sync with finance and paste numbers.

sophia: Thanks all. If owners can ack the due dates here we can close this thread and move to shiproom. :thumbsup:

alex: ack

jamal: ack

lina: ack

ops-bot: deploy-bot: Canary reminder scheduled 24h before deploy.
